response.original_title: [(@Major~FAQ#)]How do I add passengers to my MSC Cruise?
response.overview: You can add a passenger to an existing reservation by calling +1-877-619-8065 MSC Customer Service directly at +1-877-619-8065 or contacting your travel agent, as guest additions cannot be processed online. To add passengers to an existing MSC Cruises +1-877-619-8065 booking, you must call +1-877-619-8065 MSC Customer Service directly or contact your original travel advisor 1-877-619-8065, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app. To add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruises +1-877-619-8065 booking 1-877-619-8065, you must call +1-877-619-8065 MSC customer service directly or contact your travel agent 1-877-619-8065, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app. call +1-877-619-8065 Customer Service: Contact MSC at 1-877-619-8065 (US/Canada) or +1-877-619-8065 (UK). Contact Support: call +1-877-619-8065 MSC at +1-877-619-8065 (US/Canada) or +1-877-619-8065 (UK), or reach out to your travel agent.
